templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum that supplements an underlying agreement to govern the use of AI services, including rules on input/output handling, model training, and improvement.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for HIPAA-covered relationships, setting out the business associate's obligations to safeguard and handle protected health information (PHI).

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) governing access to and use of a cloud-hosted product, including support, user accounts, customer content, and usage data.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA) defining processor and subprocessor relationships, data processing obligations, and protections required under applicable data protection laws.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement governing early access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Common Paper standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) terms covering confidentiality obligations, permitted uses, exceptions, and protection of confidential information between two parties.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the parties, purpose, term, and other deal-specific details that incorporate the MNDA Standard Terms by reference.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for business partnerships, including each party's obligations, fees and payment terms, feedback rights, and other cooperation terms.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for time-limited product pilots, including access scope, evaluation use, user accounts, customer content, and pilot-period terms.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for delivering services under statements of work (SOWs), covering cooperation, change orders, acceptance, and subcontractors.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining target uptime, downtime calculations, target response times, and related service commitments for a cloud service.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement granting a limited license to install and use software, including user accounts, usage data, machine learning, and open source software terms.
